title: Proposed West Maui critical access hospital
summary: A West Maui critical access hospital drew more support on Nov. 15, when a testifier urged the council to back it. On Oct. 30 the committee deferred the item without a vote. Backers want the County to guarantee $20 million in state special purpose revenue bonds, but a county attorney sees no legal authority for that, and the acting mayor warned a default would put the county in the hospital business.

timeline.text: The hospital resolution will come back at the next council meeting.
The sponsor of a West Maui hospital resolution asked to hold it until the next council meeting.
A commissioner said a West Maui medical facility is not ready for the commission to take up.
